content.scenario: A celebrity endorses a product, but only after verifying the claims made by the manufacturer. The manufacturer is later found to have made false claims.
content.outcome: The celebrity endorser is not liable to a penalty under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, as they exercised due diligence to verify the veracity of the claims made in the advertisement.

user_queries: Can an endorser be held liable for false claims?
What is the responsibility of an endorser under the Consumer Protection Act?
How can an endorser avoid liability for false claims?
